servers.label: Google Drive
servers.notes: Requires OAuth token. Run mcp/http/google-drive/get_token.py first.

servers.label: GitHub
servers.notes: Requires github-mcp-server on PATH (go install) and GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN set in Rig Settings.

servers.label: Bank Statement
servers.notes: Via Echo/Kong. Per-run user credential in BANK_STATEMENT_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN or BANK_STATEMENT_MCP_API_KEY; opt in with BANK_STATEMENT_MCP_ENABLED=true. See mcp/http/bank-statement/README.md.
